synthesis.evidence_balance: mixed — rising guides and self-funding signals pull against name-specific weakness, rising shorts, insider selling, and an unexplained February gap; peer/estimate data entirely absent.

bull_points.claim: Free cash flow is positive, and the two most recent guidance exhibits raised the FCF outlook (132.0–137.0 → 135.0–140.0 next-fy), implying self-funding rather than distress.
Successive revenue guides have stepped UP across the last three filings (146.75–148.25 → 154.5–156.5 → 157.75–159.75), a rising-guide sequence that resists the terminal read.
The company is buying back stock, with shares out down 5.2% over ~1.7 years (115.56M → 109.55M), consistent with self-funding rather than dilution.
The 10-Q states no near-term maturity wall (NOT_STATED, a KNOWN read), removing the refinancing-cliff leg of a distress thesis.

bear_points.claim: The stock is idiosyncratically weak: NCNO returned -28.3% over 180d while IWM returned +17.0%, a -45.3 point relative gap not shared with the small-cap market.
The drawdown centred on a discrete gap-down on 2026-02-03 for which there is NO company filing to anchor a cause, and no revised-guidance 8-K to follow.
bear_points.source_ref: EDGAR 8-K item codes at the gap-down dates (not blanket-labelled earnings)

bear_points.claim: Short interest is rising sharply and elevated — 20.2M shares (+18.4% over two weeks), 18.4% of shares out, 5.6 days to cover — the market is pressing the short side.
bear_points.source_ref: FINRA consolidated short interest (settle 2026-06-30); DTC = 20,167,235 short ÷ 3,579,253 screen 90d ADV

bear_points.claim: Insiders sold, not bought: open-market buys 0 versus sells 23 (net -250.8K sh), the last as recent as 2026-07-08 — no insider conviction at the lows.
Leverage is not trivial at net-debt/EBITDA 3.5x on a GAAP basis, and the estimate is flagged as a breadth fallback that may UNDER-capture scattered debt — the real figure could be worse.

decisive_question.question: Is the ~37% de-rate a temporary overshoot on an unnamed February shock in a still-growing, self-funding SaaS franchise, or the early leg of a terminal demand/leverage problem the raised guides do not yet reflect?

evidence_for.claim: Revenue guides rose across three successive filings and FCF guidance was lifted, signalling management still sees the top line and cash generation expanding.
The 10-Q states no near-term maturity wall, and buybacks reduced shares 5.2%, both inconsistent with a liquidity-driven terminal path.

evidence_against.claim: A discrete 2026-02-03 gap-down with NO company filing to explain it, combined with rising short interest to 18.4% of float and continued insider selling, points to an unresolved fundamental concern the market is pricing.
evidence_against.source_ref: EDGAR 8-K item codes at the gap-down dates (not blanket-labelled earnings)

evidence_against.claim: The -45.3 point relative underperformance versus IWM is name-specific, not a shared-market move, so the market is discriminating against NCNO for reasons the source facts do not yet name.
